name: spreadsheet-model
title: Spreadsheet model
description: The data side of Spreadsheet, with no UI: column types, reading cells as numbers and dates, exact order-preserving 64-bit sort keys, sortRows (a WebGPU bitonic sort for number and date columns, natural text order on the CPU), selection statistics and column histograms tallied on the GPU, each with a CPU fallback that gives the same answer.
